body.x: The GREET Inc., (CEO Woo-jeong Yang) participated in ‘CES 2023’, held in Las Vegas, USA for 4 days between January 5th (Thurs) and 8th (Sun, local time).

The GREET, with the goal of reducing disposable plastic waste, has developed a convenient recycling system composed of 5 steps. The company explains that users will be able to convert disposable plastic containers into recyclable containers without additional costs or effort with a simple change. In line with this, The GREET is showcasing IoT technology-based reusable container collection stations, and aesthetic designs and user-friendly functions.

The GREET introduced its 5-step reusable container total recycling solution at this CES. It consists of △excellent design and quality reusable containers △IoT·ICT-based reusable container collection stations △state-of-the-art reusable container cleaning plant △directly managed logistics system △reusable container recycling platform.

The core of this system is the 'Full-IoT' collection station, which recognizes the type of used reusable container and returns the appropriate deposit to the user. The deposit is immediately paid to the user's registered platform account, thereby improving the efficiency of collection and improving the storage.

The GREET has signed a contract to provide reusable containers to Samsung Electronics' DX division, and is currently operating a reusable container recycling solution, providing 1.5 million reusable containers and 700~800 reusable container collection stations per month.

In Korea, the maximum daily plastic container discharge is around 20 million, and there are ongoing discussions amongst domestic regulatory authorities about regulatory measures such as enforcing environmental charges to all disposable plastic containers in the future. In response, the GREET, understanding that there are no detailed plans to solve the issue at hand, emphasized that it developed its solution to provide recycling of disposable waste without additional cost burdens for consumers, restaurants, governments, and local authorities.

body.cap: The GREET's reusable container recycling system uses a 'Full-IoT' collection station. | Provided by The GREET

body.x: The representative of The GREET stated that "While there was a goal, the public's worries about the situation were deepening because clear alternatives were not provided," and "As the platform and system responsible for presenting a better direction for the sustainability of the earth's environment, we have developed the total reusable container recycling solution."
By participating in this year's CES, The GREET aims to establish a foundation for penetrating the US/North American markets as well as other overseas markets.

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.
